mappingNote: Flags below are semantic ids owned by this packet. Earlier chapters must map their runtime flags onto these names. Do not invent DG01–DG12 flag ids here.
witnessNote: Refuse checks this fixed witness set. Each flag is produced by the critical-path action of one named room, and that room's forward door requires the flag. It is not an N-of-M collectible, and extra pickups do not count.
institutionNote: Distribute requires all four domains in the prepared set. 'unknown' is the engine value when a runtime mapping is still pending, and it does not count as prepared. Partial preparation does not unlock Distribute.
